Riding light (first light to last light, Vancouver): Tue, Nov 24 8am to 5:57pm; Wed, Nov 25 8:02am to 5:57pm; Thu, Nov 26 8:03am to 5:56pm. Hours outside that are dark and not listed; never suggest riding then.

Guillermo's own take for Tue, Nov 24 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): The easterly is building and running ahead of the page. At 7am the English Bay buoy read ENE 22 gusting 28 and Point Atkinson E 26, a few knots above the forecast.

My pick is Boundary Bay from first light, about 8am, to last light, about 5:55pm. The page says E 14 to 17, so expect a bit more. The tide stays above 11ft all day. Jericho works too if the buoy holds 18+, best this morning while the tide is high. Yesterday the beach faded in the afternoon.

EC marine forecast, Howe Sound (issued 10:10 PM PCT 24 November 2026), WARNING IN EFFECT: Tonight and Wednesday. Wind northerly outflow 15 to 25 knots except southeast 20 to 30 near the mouth of Howe Sound late this evening and overnight. Wind becoming northerly outflow 15 Wednesday morning then increasing to northerly outflow 15 to 25 early Wednesday evening except southeast 30 with gusts to 40 near the mouth of Howe Sound. Strong wind warning program has ended for the season.

EC marine forecast, Strait of Georgia (south of Nanaimo) (issued 09:30 PM PCT 24 November 2026), WARNING IN EFFECT: Tonight and Wednesday. Gale warning in effect. Wind southeast 20 to 30 knots except southeast 35 to 45 south of Tsawwassen tonight. Wind becoming southeast 15 to 25 near noon Wednesday then increasing to southeast 25 to 35 Wednesday evening except southeast 45 south of Tsawwassen. Strong wind warning program has ended for the season.
